system.description:
Invisible Threads: When you teleport between Ice Mirrors, using Reflective Movement, you can draw a line between the mirrors you teleported between, that only you can see, that lasts until the beginning of your next turn. If a hostile creature moves through this invisible line, you can spend your Reaction, to teleport to a previously occupied mirror and perform a number of attacks equal to the number of active Ice Mirrors against the triggering creature, dealing 2d6 + Modifier in cold damage, for each successful attack, and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, having their speed reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn, on a failure.

Hail Burst: You gain a rank of Mastery to Stealth. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. As part of casting a Yuki Hijutsu, you can release a cloud of snowy hail from your body filling a 15-foot cube, originating from you. This cloud totally obscures creatures within and on opposite sides of it, but vanishes at the beginning of your next turn.

Frost Splinter: When a creature destroys an Ice Mirror, you can spend your Reaction, to teleport to another active Ice Mirrors. You still take any damage that would be inflicted.
